_kopf.text: The Alias Workbench has no running process — everything happens in the Admin tab. These settings control how it writes.

_ikonText.text: Admin ships 62 function and 58 room templates, each with an icon. When the workbench creates an enumeration, it takes the icon from there. Existing enumerations keep whatever they have — unless you allow it to fill in what is missing. Nothing is ever written without the dry run showing it first.

iconRooms.label: Add missing icons to rooms
iconRooms.help: Applies when a room has no icon at all and a template of the same name or ID exists.

iconFunctions.label: Add missing icons to functions
iconFunctions.help: Same for functions. Enumerations mirrored from a HomeMatic CCU never carry an icon.

iconReplace.label: Also replace unusable icon entries
iconReplace.help: The Admin setup wizard leaves a bare name such as "Playroom" in the icon field, which no longer resolves to a picture and shows as a broken box. With this on, the workbench replaces it. It overwrites a field that is not empty — the dry run names it explicitly.

templatesFromAdmin.label: Offer the Admin's room and function templates
templatesFromAdmin.help: The workbench reads them at runtime from the Admin's own bundle instead of keeping a copy that would age with every update. If that fails, the selection lists simply show what already exists — no error, just fewer entries.

_mqttText.text: The Tasmota helpers need command points (cmnd.…) in the MQTT adapter's tree — to query a device, to switch on SetOption59, and as the send point of an alias. An adapter normally writes only into its own area, which is why this is off by default. With it off, the workbench still reads everything and builds aliases on points that already exist; it just creates and changes nothing in the MQTT adapter.

mqttObjects.label: Allow creating and changing data points in the MQTT adapter
mqttObjects.help: Creates cmnd points under mqtt-client.0.… and enables sending on existing ones. Takes effect immediately, without reloading the workbench.
